name: Ambren Hatchet
description: A hatchet forged from Ambren. Suitable for cutting Lanai trees.

name: Serph Hatchet
description: A hatchet forged from Serph.

name: Azulyss Hatchet
description: A hatchet forged from Azulyss.

name: Pylerial Hatchet
description: A hatchet forged from Pylerial.

name: Midrath Hatchet
description: A hatchet forged from Midrath.

name: Thaeldavast Hatchet
description: A hatchet forged from Thaeldavast.

name: Ghaal Hatchet
description: A hatchet forged from Ghaal.

name: Runafax Hatchet
description: A hatchet forged from Runafax.

name: Talamir Hatchet
description: A hatchet forged from Talamir. The finest cutting edge known to Talaran.

name: Poor Lanai Log
description: A Lanai log of poor quality. Likely from a dead or damaged tree.

name: Fine Lanai Log
description: A solid Lanai log of decent quality.

name: Excellent Lanai Log
description: A pristine Lanai log. Sought after by carpenters and craftsmen.

name: Poor Hatch Log
description: A Hatch log of poor quality.

name: Fine Hatch Log
description: A solid Hatch log of decent quality.

name: Excellent Hatch Log
description: A pristine Hatch log.

name: Poor Bearn Log
description: A Bearn log of poor quality.

name: Fine Bearn Log
description: A solid Bearn log of decent quality.

name: Excellent Bearn Log
description: A pristine Bearn log.

name: Poor Mirrith Log
description: A Mirrith log of poor quality.

name: Fine Mirrith Log
description: A solid Mirrith log of decent quality.

name: Excellent Mirrith Log
description: A pristine Mirrith log.

name: Poor Craxial Log
description: A Craxial log of poor quality. Even poor Craxial wood is extraordinarily dense.

name: Fine Craxial Log
description: A solid Craxial log. Remarkably heavy.

name: Excellent Craxial Log
description: A flawless Craxial log. Masters of Carpentry speak of these in reverent tones.

name: Ambren Pickaxe
description: A pickaxe forged from Ambren. Suitable for mining basic ores.

name: Serph Pickaxe
description: A pickaxe forged from Serph.

name: Azulyss Pickaxe
description: A pickaxe forged from Azulyss.

name: Pylerial Pickaxe
description: A pickaxe forged from Pylerial.

name: Midrath Pickaxe
description: A pickaxe forged from Midrath.

name: Thaeldavast Pickaxe
description: A pickaxe forged from Thaeldavast.

name: Ghaal Pickaxe
description: A pickaxe forged from Ghaal.

name: Runafax Pickaxe
description: A pickaxe forged from Runafax.

name: Talamir Pickaxe
description: A pickaxe forged from Talamir. The finest mining tool in Talaran.

name: Granite
description: A chunk of rough granite. Useful in construction.

name: Limestone
description: A block of limestone. Widely used in building.

name: Sandstone
description: A piece of sandstone. Easy to shape.

name: Marble
description: A slab of marble. Prized for its beauty.

name: Basalt
description: Dense volcanic basalt. Incredibly durable.

name: Ambren Ore
description: A component ore used in Ambren alloy.

name: Burgh Ore
description: A component ore used in Ambren alloy.

name: Serph Ore
description: A single ore that smelts into Serph.

name: Azulyss Ore
description: A single ore that smelts into Azulyss.

name: Ore 3
description: An alloy component ore.

name: Ore 4
description: An alloy component ore.

name: Midrath Ore
description: A single ore that smelts into Midrath.

name: Ore 5
description: An alloy component ore.

name: Ore 6
description: An alloy component ore.

name: Ghaal Ore
description: A single ore that smelts into Ghaal.

name: Runafax Ore
description: A single ore that smelts into Runafax.

name: Ore 7
description: An alloy component ore.

name: Dense Ambren Ore
description: A dense Mallis ore. Smelts into extra bars.

name: Dense Burgh Ore
description: A dense Stren ore. Smelts into extra bars.

name: Dense Serph Ore
description: A dense Serph ore. Smelts into extra bars.

name: Dense Azulyss Ore
description: A dense Azulyss ore. Smelts into extra bars.

name: Dense Midrath Ore
description: A dense Midrath ore. Smelts into extra bars.

name: Dense Ghaal Ore
description: A dense Ghaal ore. Smelts into extra bars.

name: Dense Runafax Ore
description: A dense Runafax ore. Smelts into extra bars.

name: Ambren Hammer
description: A heavy hammer used for shaping hot metal on an anvil.

name: Ambren Tongs
description: Iron tongs for handling hot metal safely.

name: Lanai Bucket
description: A stout wooden bucket, staved and bound. Carries water for the forge or the field, and holds ten of milk besides.

name: Ambren Anvil
description: A sturdy Ambren anvil. Required for smithing tier 1 items.

name: Charc
description: Produced from burning wood in a kiln. Used as fuel for smelting.

name: Koric
description: Processed fuel. Required for smelting higher-tier metals.

name: Ambren Ingot
description: An ingot of Ambren alloy. Used to forge tier 1 tools and equipment.

name: Leather Strips
description: Rough-cut strips of leather. Cordage, bindings, and a hundred small uses.

name: Lanai Tool Rod
description: A smooth rod of Lanai wood. Used as a handle for tools.

name: Novice's Pony
description: A gentle pony given to new arrivals in Talaran. A humble but reliable companion for your first journeys.

name: Lanai Planks
description: Planks of Lanai wood, sawn smooth and ready for the workbench.

name: Hatch Planks
description: Sturdy Hatch planks, sawn and squared.

name: Bearn Planks
description: Heavy Bearn planks with a tight, even grain.

name: Mirrith Planks
description: Pale Mirrith planks, prized for fine work.

name: Craxial Planks
description: Dense Craxial planks. Remarkably heavy, and remarkably strong.

name: Lanai Sawhorse
description: A sturdy sawhorse of Lanai wood, the surface of a carpenter's workstation.

name: Ambren Saw
description: A saw with an Ambren blade and a Lanai handle. Carried in the off hand, and wanted for every plank.

name: Ambren Plane
description: A plane with an Ambren blade and a Lanai handle. Part of a Carpentry workstation.

name: Bird Nest
description: A small nest knocked loose from the branches. Something may be tucked inside.

name: Sawdust
description: Fine wood powder left over from sawing. Burns well and has its uses.

name: Lanai Bark
description: Rough bark stripped from Lanai logs.

name: Hatch Bark
description: Rough bark stripped from Hatch logs.

name: Bearn Bark
description: Rough bark stripped from Bearn logs.

name: Mirrith Bark
description: Rough bark stripped from Mirrith logs.

name: Craxial Bark
description: Rough bark stripped from Craxial logs.

name: Rough Quartz
description: An uncut chunk of quartz, dug from the rock. A jeweler could cut and polish it.

name: Lanai Staff
description: A simple walking staff carved from Lanai wood. Eases the burden of long roads on foot.

name: Daisy
description: A simple white daisy, common along the roadsides of Taiar Island.

name: Taiaria
description: A delicate bloom named for the island itself, found tucked in shaded grass.

name: Tal's Hope
description: A rare flower said to bloom where fortune lingers. Finding one is a small blessing.

name: Tarnished Coin
description: An old coin worn smooth by time. Someone, long ago, dropped it on this road.

name: Chipped Arrowhead
description: A flint arrowhead, chipped from use or age. A relic of some forgotten hunt.

name: Four-Leaf Clover
description: One leaf more than nature intended. Kept by the hopeful and the desperate alike.

name: Lanai Hunting Bow
description: A bow of supple Lanai wood, strung for the hunt. Draws a steady arrow on forest game.

name: Ambren Arrow
description: A broadhead hunting arrow. Often recovered from a clean kill.

name: Venison
description: Raw venison from a felled deer. Best cooked before eating.

name: Boar Meat
description: Coarse, rich meat from a wild boar. Hearty fare once cooked.

name: Sloth Meat
description: A great quantity of dense meat from a ground sloth. A feast in the making.

name: Deerhide
description: The hide of a deer. Tans into a small amount of leather.

name: Boarhide
description: Tough, bristled boar hide. Yields a sturdy leather.

name: Slothhide
description: The heavy hide of a ground sloth. Difficult to work, but yields good leather.

name: Bones
description: A set of animal bones. They must be good for something.

name: Antler
description: A branching deer antler. Prized by craftsmen and collectors alike.

name: Boar Tusk
description: A curved, ivory-white tusk from a wild boar.

name: Sloth Claw
description: An enormous curved claw from a ground sloth. Heavier than it looks.

name: Snare
description: A cordage loop on a bent-sapling spring. The trapper's oldest friend.

name: Buckskin
description: Soft, supple leather worked from a wild hide. A hunter's material, not a tanner's trade good.

name: Feathers
description: Stiff flight feathers. Essential fletching for any arrow.

name: Rabbit Meat
description: Lean rabbit meat. Best cooked before eating.

name: Pheasant Meat
description: A plump pheasant breast. Best cooked before eating.

name: Rabbit Fur
description: A soft rabbit pelt, warm despite its size.

name: Rabbit's Foot
description: A preserved rabbit's foot. Said to carry luck for its keeper.

name: Prized Plume
description: A single flawless tail feather, banded in color. Far too perfect to fletch.

name: Squonk Tears
description: A small vial of sorrowful tears is all that remains when a Squonk is caught.

name: Lanai Tanning Rack
description: A frame of Lanai wood for stretching hides. The heart of a tanner's station.

name: Lanai Arrow Shafts
description: Straight lengths of split Lanai, planed round and waiting for a head.

name: Lanai Tanning Barrel
description: A stout Lanai barrel, bound with split wooden hoops. Bark liquor goes in dark and comes out darker.

name: Foraging Basket
description: A wide reed basket. Carrying more means bringing a little more home each time.

name: Ambren Foraging Knife
description: A slim Ambren blade for cutting stems and roots cleanly. Quickens the work.

name: Leather Foraging Gloves
description: Supple leather gloves, seams turned inward. Nettles, brambles, and thorns hold no sting for hands so covered.

name: Chamomile
description: Small daisy-like flowers, apple-sweet. Steeped for a calming tea.

name: Dandelion
description: Root, leaf, and flower. Every part of the humble dandelion has a use.

name: Yarrow
description: A feathery-leaved herb long carried to staunch bleeding.

name: Wild Clover
description: Sweet three-leafed clover. Good fodder, and better luck if you find its fourth leaf.

name: Wild Strawberry
description: Tiny, intensely sweet berries hidden low in the meadow grass.

name: Wild Thyme
description: A low, creeping herb sharp with fragrance.

name: Lavender
description: Purple spikes heavy with scent. Prized for calm and for flavour.

name: Faelight Bloom
description: A pale flower that only opens at dusk, glowing faintly. The old folk left the field before it did.

name: Chanterelle Mushroom
description: Golden, funnel-shaped, faintly apricot. A forager's prize on any table.

name: Wild Garlic
description: Broad green leaves that betray themselves by scent. Ramps, some call them.

name: Acorns
description: Oak mast. Bitter until leached, then ground into a hearty flour.

name: Fiddlehead Ferns
description: Tightly coiled young fern shoots, gathered before they unfurl.

name: Hazelnuts
description: Rich, oily nuts in the husk. A squirrel's treasure and a baker's.

name: Morel Mushroom
description: Honeycombed and hollow, appearing only briefly. Coveted, and never where you looked last.

name: Oak Gall
description: A hard brown swelling on an oak twig, born of a wasp. Crushed and steeped, it makes a black and lasting ink.

name: Witch's Butter
description: A quivering yellow jelly-fungus on dead wood. To find it on your gate, the old wives said, meant a witch had you in mind.

name: Ghost Pipe
description: A waxen white plant with no green in it at all, feeding on the forest's dead. It blackens at a touch.

name: Watercress
description: Peppery green leaves gathered from cold running water.

name: Wild Mint
description: Bruise a leaf and the whole bank smells of it.

name: Cattail Root
description: Starchy rhizomes from the reed beds. Filling, once cleaned and cooked.

name: Reeds
description: Long, pliant water-reeds. Dried and woven into baskets and mats.

name: Willow Bark
description: Strips of bitter bark. Chewed against aches long before anyone knew why it worked.

name: Meadowsweet
description: Frothy cream-white flowers, almond-scented, crowding the wet ground.

name: Frogspawn
description: A cool clutch of jelly and dark eyes from the shallows. Unpleasant, and useful.

name: Wisp Cap
description: A marsh mushroom that glows a cold green after dark. Follow its light and you'll find only bog.

name: Blackberries
description: Dark, seedy, sun-warm. The hedgerow's reward for a scratched hand.

name: Raspberries
description: Soft red berries that come away from the cane like little thimbles.

name: Rosehips
description: The scarlet fruit of the wild rose, tart and rich once the seeds are cleaned out.

name: Stinging Nettle
description: It bites the bare hand, but cooking draws the sting and leaves only good green nourishment.

name: Bramble Vine
description: Tough, thorned, and endlessly long. Stripped of thorns, it binds and weaves.

name: Hawthorn Haw
description: Small red hedge-fruit from the hawthorn. The tree of the good folk, cut it and regret it.

name: Elderberry
description: Heavy umbels of tiny dark berries. Never eaten raw; always cooked.

name: Sloe Berries
description: The blackthorn's bitter blue-black fruit, gathered after the first frost.

name: Blackthorn Sprig
description: A straight, wicked-thorned length of blackthorn. The wood of cursing-rods and blackthorn wands.

name: Hedgewitch's Sprig
description: A small bundle of herbs bound with red thread. Plainly tied by hand, though no one lives near this hedge...

name: Carrot Seeds
description: A pinch of fine carrot seed from a bolted wild plant. Sow it in tilled ground.

name: Onion Seeds
description: Small black onion seeds. Sown in good soil, they raise a crop of onions.

name: Turnip Seeds
description: A hardy, fast root crop. Good on the table and better as fodder.

name: Wild Grain
description: A handful of wild grain heads. Sown it yields wheat or barley; left whole it feeds livestock.

name: Flax Seeds
description: Flat brown flax seed. Grown for its long fibres, and its oil.

name: Pea Seeds
description: Dried peas for sowing. The plant feeds the soil as much as the pot.

name: Strawberry Runner
description: A rooted runner pinched from a wild strawberry, ready to replant.

name: Raspberry Cane
description: A cutting of wild raspberry cane that will root and fruit for years.

name: Ambren Hoe
description: A broad Ambren blade on a stout haft, for breaking and turning soil.

name: Granite Block
description: A squared, dressed block of granite. The bones of any building worth the name.

name: Fence Panel
description: A section of post-and-rail fencing, ready to set into the ground. Field-edges are made of these.

name: Ambren Nails
description: A fistful of hand-hammered Ambren nails. Nothing holds timber to timber like them.

name: Carrot
description: A firm, sweet root, pulled from turned earth rather than found wild.

name: Onion
description: A papery-skinned bulb that makes the difference in half the pots in Talaran.

name: Turnip
description: A hardy root. Good on the table, better in a lean winter, fine as fodder.

name: Peas
description: Green peas in the pod. The plant leaves the soil richer than it found it.

name: Grain
description: Threshed heads of grain. Ground to flour for bread, or fed whole to livestock.

name: Flax
description: Cut flax stalks. Rotted, beaten, and combed, they give up long linen fibres.

name: Strawberry
description: A plump cultivated strawberry, larger and sweeter than its wild cousin.

name: Raspberry
description: Cultivated raspberries from a tended cane. A bush that gives for years.

name: Garlic Cloves
description: A head of garlic broken into cloves. Each one, set in the ground, becomes a head of its own.

name: Garlic
description: Fat cultivated garlic, cured and plaited. Sharper by far than the wild kind.

name: Manure
description: Well-rotted muck from the byre. Unlovely, and worth more to a field than gold.

name: Grain Sheaves
description: Cut stalks bound into sheaves, the ears still heavy on them. Wants threshing.

name: Straw
description: Dry stalks left once the grain is beaten free. Bedding, thatch, and winter fodder.

name: Flour
description: Stone-ground flour, still warm from the millstone. Bread begins here.

name: Acorn Flour
description: Acorns leached of their bitterness and ground coarse. Famine food, and honest enough.

name: Retted Flax
description: Flax left to rot in still water until the woody core lets go of the fibre.

name: Linen Fibres
description: Long, pale, combed-out flax fibre. Ready for the wheel.

name: Linen Thread
description: Spun linen thread, strong and cool to the touch.

name: Linen Cloth
description: A woven bolt of linen. The plainest cloth worth wearing.

name: Lanai Mallet
description: A heavy mallet of solid Lanai wood. Drives a chisel without splitting the haft, and sets a beam without marring it.

name: Admin Horse
description: A horse of impossible temperament, saddled for those who built the roads. It does not so much travel as arrive.

name: Chick
description: A ball of yellow down with an opinion. Cheeping, constantly.

name: Calf
description: Knock-kneed and enormous-eyed. It will follow anything that feeds it.

name: Piglet
description: Pink, bristled, and already rooting at the ground for something better.

name: Rouncey Foal
description: All legs and no sense. In a year it will carry you the length of the island.

name: Palfrey Foal
description: Finer-boned than a rouncey foal, and it already knows it.

name: Egg
description: Still warm from the straw. The beginning of a great many recipes.

name: Milk
description: A pail of it, sweet and frothing. It will not keep long.

name: Truffle
description: Knuckled, black, and smelling of the forest floor. The sow found it; the sow does not get it.

name: Chicken Meat
description: Plucked and drawn, ready for the spit.

name: Beef
description: Heavy red cuts. A single beast feeds a household for a week.

name: Pork
description: Fat-marbled and generous. Nothing of a pig goes to waste.

name: Cowhide
description: A whole hide off a farmed beast, stiff and raw. Bark and time will make leather of it.

name: Leather
description: A supple tanned sheet. Everything a strip cannot do begins here.

name: Feed Pail
description: A banded wooden pail. Carries feed out and milk back.

name: Mucking Fork
description: Long-tined and worn smooth at the haft. The least loved tool on any farm.

name: Halter & Lead
description: Plaited strips and a good buckle. The difference between a horse and your horse.

name: Rouncey
description: An honest, thick-set riding horse. No breeding to speak of and no complaints either.

name: Palfrey
description: Smooth-gaited and bred for the long road. A day in this saddle costs you nothing.

name: Ambren Butchering Knife
description: A broad, heavy blade with a curved belly. Made for one job, and unpleasant at every other.

name: Butter
description: A pale golden pat, worked and salted. Keeps a week in a cold larder and improves everything it touches.

name: Cheese
description: A firm pressed round with a rind coming on. Milk made patient enough to travel.

name: Bucket of Milk
description: A sealed bucket, cool and heavy. Ten good measures of milk, and the lid stays on until you need it.

name: Leather Boots
description: Stitched and double-soled. The road is just as long, but it stops arguing with your feet.

name: Tiddle
description: Barely a fish at all. Half tadpole, half ambition, and entirely too pleased with itself.

name: Brook Dace
description: A quick silver minnow of the shallows. Travels in numbers and panics as one.

name: Perch
description: Striped and spiny-backed, bold enough to strike at anything that moves.

name: Burbot
description: The only cod that ever forsook the sea. Ugly, cold-blooded, and best sought under winter ice.

name: Chalkarp
description: A pale, heavy-bodied carp that noses the chalk beds at first light. Uncommonly fond of curd.

name: Pike
description: All teeth and patience. The lake keeps nothing it has not permitted the pike to keep.

name: Frostgill
description: Its gills carry a rime that will not melt in the hand. It rises only when the lake runs cold.

name: Whiting
description: Plain, pale, and plentiful. This fish has fed more coastal families than any other.

name: Black Bream
description: Deep-bodied and dark-flanked, drawn into the warm shallows of high summer.

name: Dawn Sprat
description: A sliver of living silver. It shoals in the first grey hour and is gone by full light.

name: Garfish
description: A green-boned needle of a fish. Startling to look at, and stranger still to clean.

name: John Dory
description: A flat, mournful fish with a dark thumbprint on each flank. Slow, and far too easily caught.

name: Gurnard
description: It walks the seabed on finger-like fins and grumbles aloud when landed. An honest oddity.

name: Conger Eel
description: A great muscular rope of a fish that hunts the dark. Landing one is an argument, not a catch.

name: Duskfin
description: Its fins hold the last colour of the day. No net has ever taken one, and no sun has ever seen one.

name: Wolffish
description: Blunt-headed and crowded with crushing teeth, built for cold water and hard shells.

name: Stormer
description: It runs the coast ahead of the autumn gales. The fishermen say it knows the weather before the sky does.

name: Sabreling
description: A long curved blade of a fish that hunts the night tide. Handle it by the tail, never the flank.

name: Ambren Hook
description: A small barbed hook of Ambren, filed sharp and bent true. Useless alone, and essential all the same.

name: Ambren Fishing Rod
description: A supple Lanai pole, a length of linen line, and an Ambren hook. It asks only for patience.

name: Fishing Net
description: A wide mesh of knotted linen on a plank frame. It takes the small and the many, never the great.

name: River Mussel
description: A knuckle of dark shell, clamped shut and gritty with silt. Something rattles faintly inside, or possibly nothing does.

name: Bog Lanai
description: Lanai that lay under the lake so long it turned black and hard as iron. Too fine to burn and too stubborn to waste.

name: Locked Rusty Chest
description: A small strongbox furred with rust, its lock seized solid. Someone lost this over a gunwale a long time ago.

name: Rusty Chest
description: The lid gives at last, on a hinge that has forgotten how. Whatever the sea left inside is yours now.

name: Amber
description: A warm gold nodule polished smooth by the tide. Hold it to the light and something very old is caught inside.

name: Freshwater Pearl
description: Small, irregular, and the colour of a rain cloud with the sun behind it. Worth more than the fish that shared its bed.

name: Gold
description: Coin of the realm. Found in stranger places than you would expect.

name: Granite Mortar and Pestle
description: A heavy granite bowl worn smooth, for bruising herbs and grinding seed.

name: Ambren Cauldron
description: A deep belly of hammered ambren, made to hang over a fire all day.

name: Ambren Skillet
description: A shallow pan with a long handle, for anything wanting a quick fierce heat.

name: Ambren Cooking Knife
description: A short blade kept keen for paring, slicing and fine work.

name: Ambren Meat Cleaver
description: Broad and weighty, meant to come down once and part the joint.

name: Ambren Ladle
description: A long-handled bowl for lifting broth without scalding your knuckles.

name: Ambren Flesh Hook
description: A two-pronged hook for drawing meat out of a boiling pot.

name: Burnt Fish
description: Black on the outside, dry to the bone. Not worth the eating.

name: Burnt Meat
description: Charred through and gone to leather. The dogs might take it.

name: Cooked Tiddle
description: Tiddle cooked through, the skin crisped and the flesh come away clean.

name: Cooked Whiting
description: Whiting cooked through, the skin crisped and the flesh come away clean.

name: Roast Rabbit
description: Rabbit Meat roasted over the fire until the juices run clear.

name: Roast Chicken
description: Chicken Meat roasted over the fire until the juices run clear.

name: Roast Pheasant
description: Pheasant Meat roasted over the fire until the juices run clear.

name: Roast Venison
description: Venison roasted over the fire until the juices run clear.

name: Cooked Brook Dace
description: Brook Dace cooked through, the skin crisped and the flesh come away clean.

name: Cooked Black Bream
description: Black Bream cooked through, the skin crisped and the flesh come away clean.

name: Cooked Perch
description: Perch cooked through, the skin crisped and the flesh come away clean.

name: Cooked Dawn Sprat
description: Dawn Sprat cooked through, the skin crisped and the flesh come away clean.

name: Cooked Burbot
description: Burbot cooked through, the skin crisped and the flesh come away clean.

name: Cooked Garfish
description: Garfish cooked through, the skin crisped and the flesh come away clean.

name: Cooked Chalkarp
description: Chalkarp cooked through, the skin crisped and the flesh come away clean.

name: Cooked John Dory
description: John Dory cooked through, the skin crisped and the flesh come away clean.

name: Cooked Gurnard
description: Gurnard cooked through, the skin crisped and the flesh come away clean.

name: Cooked Conger Eel
description: Conger Eel cooked through, the skin crisped and the flesh come away clean.

name: Cooked Pike
description: Pike cooked through, the skin crisped and the flesh come away clean.

name: Cooked Duskfin
description: Duskfin cooked through, the skin crisped and the flesh come away clean.

name: Cooked Frostgill
description: Frostgill cooked through, the skin crisped and the flesh come away clean.

name: Cooked Wolffish
description: Wolffish cooked through, the skin crisped and the flesh come away clean.

name: Cooked Stormer
description: Stormer cooked through, the skin crisped and the flesh come away clean.

name: Cooked Sabreling
description: Sabreling cooked through, the skin crisped and the flesh come away clean.

name: Roast Beef
description: Beef roasted over the fire until the juices run clear.

name: Roast Boar
description: Boar Meat roasted over the fire until the juices run clear.

name: Roast Pork
description: Pork roasted over the fire until the juices run clear.

name: Roast Sloth
description: Sloth Meat roasted over the fire until the juices run clear.

name: Burnt Pottage
description: Caught on the bottom and stirred through. The whole pot tastes of it.

name: Burnt Pastry
description: Black underneath and raw in the middle. A rare achievement.

name: Root Pottage
description: Roots simmered soft and salted. Plain, hot, and enough.

name: Coney Stew
description: Rabbit stewed down with roots until it falls off the bone.

name: Fern and Garlic Fry
description: Young fern heads caught quickly in a hot pan with garlic.

name: Mushroom Pottage
description: Chanterelles cooked down dark and earthy with thyme.

name: Venison and Root Stew
description: Venison and roots given long enough to forget they were tough.

name: Flatbread
description: Flour and water pressed flat and blistered on the stone.

name: Oatcake
description: Coarse, dry and filling. Keeps for days in a pack.

name: Watercress Broth
description: A thin green broth, peppery and sharper than it looks.

name: Buttered Eggs
description: Eggs taken off the heat while still loose, soft with butter.

name: Fish Stew
description: Whatever came out of the water, flaked into broth with roots.

name: Cottage Loaf
description: A proper loaf with a hard crust and a soft, open crumb.

name: Beef and Root Stew
description: Beef stewed until the roots have taken all the flavour they can.

name: Herb Bannock
description: A flat buttered loaf, green-flecked and smelling of thyme.

name: Nettle Broth
description: Nettles boiled until they lose their nerve. Better than it sounds.

name: Mussel Chowder
description: Mussels steamed open and stirred through milk and butter.

name: Hazelnut Loaf
description: Dense and sweet-edged, shot through with crushed hazelnut.

name: Onion Pasty
description: Onions cooked to sweetness and shut inside a buttered crust.

name: Morel Omelette
description: Eggs folded over morels while the middle is still soft.

name: Poacher's Pie
description: Whatever the snares gave up, under a lid of pastry.

name: Curd Tart
description: Fresh curds set with egg in a thin pastry case.

name: Cheese and Onion Pasty
description: Sharp cheese and soft onion, hot enough to burn your mouth.

name: Fish Pie
description: Fish and milk under a browned crust, steaming when it is cut.

name: Cheese Twist
description: Pastry turned over on itself with cheese between every fold.

name: Truffled Eggs
description: Eggs left overnight beside a truffle, then cooked slow in butter.

name: Garlic Roast Pork
description: Pork studded with garlic and turned until the skin cracks.

name: Truffle and Egg Pie
description: Extravagant and not boastful about it. Truffle and egg beneath pastry.

name: Game Pie
description: Everything the hunt brought back, under one raised crust.

name: Straw Skep
description: A dome of coiled straw, bound tight. Empty, and waiting for a colony.

name: Skep of Bees
description: The same dome, humming. Carry it gently and do not set it down hard.

name: Honeycomb
description: Heavy wax comb, capped and dripping. Press it to part the honey from the wax.

name: Honey
description: Strained from crushed comb and kept in a sealed crock. Sweet enough to preserve anything.

name: Beeswax
description: Pale blocks pressed from spent comb. Burns clean and keeps water out of everything.

name: Wild Hive
description: A colony found in a hollow trunk. It will go into a skep, if you brought one.

name: Rosehip Syrup
description: Rosehips boiled down thick and strained. Tart under the sweetness.

name: Bramble Conserve
description: Blackberries cooked down with honey until they hold their shape and no more.

name: Honey Cake
description: Dark, heavy and sticky at the base where the honey settled.

name: Elderberry Cordial
description: Steeped dark and sweetened. Drunk hot against the cold months.

name: Strawberry Tart
description: Berries glazed with honey in a thin case, best eaten the day it is made.

name: Raspberry Tart
description: Sharper than the strawberry and better for it.

name: Lavender Honey Cake
description: Perfumed and just short of soapy. The line between the two is the skill.

name: Honey Glazed Boar
description: Basted until the outside turns to lacquer and catches on the teeth.

name: Witch's Butter Confit
description: A jelly fungus candied slow in honey. Stranger than it tastes.

name: Chamomile Tisane
description: Steeped pale gold and drunk slowly. Steadies the hands for half an hour.

name: Mint Tisane
description: Sharp enough to clear the head. The miles go easier after it.

name: Meadowsweet Draught
description: Almond-sweet and faintly medicinal. Whatever you are doing, it goes quicker.

name: Dandelion Cordial
description: Bitter under the honey. Foragers swear it sharpens the eye for what is worth taking.

name: Lavender Tisane
description: Perfumed and calming. Work done under it seems to come out twice as often.

name: Ploughman's Lunch
description: Bread, cheese and a raw onion. Eaten leaning on a gate, traditionally.

name: Woodsman's Bannock
description: Heavy enough to carry a day of felling. Keeps in a pocket.

name: Miner's Pasty
description: A crust thick enough to hold in a dirty hand and throw away after.

name: Fisherman's Stew
description: Yesterday's stew, made worth eating again. Every riverside cook knows the trick.

name: Drover's Pottage
description: Bread boiled soft with garlic. Eaten standing, usually while something escapes.

name: Wayfarer's Cake
description: Dense, sweet and slow to stale. Made to be eaten a long way from here.

name: Hedgerow Basket
description: Everything the hedge gave up, laid out properly. Nothing here was cooked.

name: Poacher's Supper
description: Eaten quickly and away from the road, on the whole.

name: Smith's Supper
description: Beef and bread and nothing else. A smith does not want to think about lunch.

name: Wright's Loaf
description: Split, buttered and pressed back together. Travels in a toolbag without complaint.

name: Ambren Tinderbox
description: A small hinged box of char cloth and struck steel. Keeps a spark dry in weather that would kill one.

name: Ambren Spear
description: A leaf-shaped head on a stout Lanai shaft. It keeps a beast at the length of your arm, and a little more.

name: Ambren Scimitar
description: A curved blade that wants to draw across, not hack down. Light enough to carry a shield beside it.

name: Ambren Mace
description: A flanged head on a short haft, made for things that wear their armour on the outside.

name: Ambren Daggers
description: A matched pair, one for each hand. Quick work, close in.

name: Ambren Hand Axes
description: Two short axes with bearded heads. A woodsman's tools, sharpened for other work.

name: Ambren War Hammers
description: A pair of hammers with a spike behind each face. Heavy in the wrist by the end of the day.

name: Ambren Atgeir
description: A broad spearhead with a hooked spur, on a haft as tall as a man. Both hands, and plenty of room.

name: Ambren Greatsword
description: Near as long as the one who carries it. It swings slow and lands like a falling bough.

name: Ambren Maul
description: A block of Ambren on a thick haft. Lift it, let it fall, lift it again.

name: Ambren Bracers
description: Plates laced over the forearms. Enough to turn a glancing blow.

name: Ambren Boots
description: Stout boots with Ambren plates riveted over the toe and shin.

name: Ambren Coif
description: A hood of riveted rings that falls to the shoulders.

name: Ambren Buckler
description: A small round shield gripped in the fist. Quick to raise.

name: Ambren Chausses
description: Leggings of linked rings, laced to a belt. Noisy on stairs.

name: Ambren Hauberk
description: A long shirt of rings over a leather backing. Heavy on the shoulders and welcome everywhere else.

name: Ambren Gauntlets
description: Jointed plates over a leather glove, each finger its own small shell.

name: Ambren Sabatons
description: Plate shoes in overlapping lames. You hear the wearer coming.

name: Ambren Helm
description: A rounded cap of plate with a nasal guard down the face.

name: Ambren Kite Shield
description: Tall and tapered, wide enough at the top to cover the chest and long enough to guard the knee.

name: Ambren Greaves
description: Shaped plates that strap over the shins and knees.

name: Ambren Cuirass
description: Breast and back plates buckled at the sides over a leather jack. The best Ambren a smith can put on a body.

name: Hodag Horn
description: A single horn off a Hodag's brow, long as a spear and sharpened by the beast itself on every tree in the Grove.

name: Wrecker's Cutlass
description: A ship's blade, taken off a drowned man and kept bright since. The wrecker never told anyone which ship.

name: Gouger's Legbone
description: The long leg of a Sidehill Gouger, the one it walked the downhill side on. Heavy at the knuckle end. Swung with both hands.

name: Crabshell Gauntlets
description: Claw plates off a Shore Crab, laced over the back of the hand. Lighter than iron and harder than it looks.

name: Crabshell Sabatons
description: Two halves of a crab's back, shaped to the foot. They clack on stone.

name: Crabshell Helm
description: A whole carapace, scraped out and lined with leather. It still smells of the tide.

name: Crabshell Shield
description: A plate off Ol' Shellback's back, barnacles and all. Blows skate off it.

name: Crabshell Greaves
description: Leg plates cut from the old crab's shell, strapped over shin and knee.

name: Crabshell Cuirass
description: The great crab's breastplate, near a hand thick. Whatever grew this lived a long time.

name: Jackalope Antler
description: One tine of a jackalope's crown. People who have never seen one will tell you they are made up.

name: Wolf Fang
description: A long yellow fang from a grey wolf. Hunters wear them on a cord, and so do people who want to be taken for hunters.

name: Wrecker's Lantern
description: A shuttered lantern with a red glass. Hung on the rocks at night, it looked like the harbour light.

name: Knocker's Hammer
description: A hammer the size of your thumb, its head of old black iron. The miners say to leave it where you found it. You did not.

name: Agropelter Knuckle
description: A knobbed joint off an agropelter's long arm, hard as a burl.

name: Rough Garnet
description: A dark red knot in the grey rock, no bigger than a pea. It looks like nothing much until it is cut.

name: Wolf Pelt
description: A grey wolf's coat, thick at the ruff and coarse down the spine. Sewn together, a few of these would keep a winter out.

name: Cut Quartz
description: A quartz cut clean, with flat faces that catch the light.

name: Polished Quartz
description: A quartz ground and polished until it is clear as a still pool.

name: Flawless Quartz
description: A quartz without a single cloud or crack in it. A cutter waits a long time for one of these.

name: Cut Garnet
description: A garnet cut into faces, the colour of dark wine.

name: Polished Garnet
description: A polished garnet. Held up to a candle it glows red right through.

name: Flawless Garnet
description: A flawless garnet, deep red and clear to the heart. Nobody who sees it forgets it.

name: Lanai Lap Wheel
description: A wheel of Lanai wood faced with ground granite, turned by a treadle. A gem held to it loses its rough skin a grain at a time.

name: Ambren Gem Chisel
description: A short Ambren chisel with a fine edge, for splitting a stone along its grain before it goes to the wheel.

name: Lit Quartz
description: A cut quartz with a little light caught inside it. It is warm in the hand, as if it had been lying in the sun.

name: Bright Quartz
description: A polished quartz full of a steady light. In a dark room it throws a pale glow on your palm.

name: Radiant Quartz
description: A flawless quartz brimming with light. It hums, very faintly, if you hold it to your ear.

name: Lit Garnet
description: A cut garnet lit from within, the colour of an ember in the morning ash.

name: Bright Garnet
description: A polished garnet glowing like a coal. The light inside it moves when you do.

name: Radiant Garnet
description: A flawless garnet so full of light it seems to breathe. Nobody holds one for long without smiling.

name: Writ of Sending
description: A folded letter in a careful hand, sealed with grey wax pressed flat by a thumb. It tells how a thing set down in one place may be asked to be in another. Most of it is about asking politely.

name: Writ of Kindling
description: A sheet of thin hide, scorched brown along one edge, folded small and pressed into a seam of the rock. The writing is close and steady. It is about calling people to a place, and keeping them there a while.

name: Writ of the Open Door
description: A strip of bark, rolled tight and tied with gut. Someone cut a doorway into the inner face with a knife point, and wrote around it in a ring. The ring has no beginning that anyone can find.

name: Ambren Jeweller's Pliers
description: Small pliers with fine jaws, drawn from Ambren and filed until they close without a gap. For bending a claw over a stone and not chipping it.

name: Quartz Keeper's Band
description: A plain Ambren band with quartz set flush around it. Kit carried by its wearer seems to forget the knocks it takes.

name: Quartz Prospector's Ring
description: A heavy Ambren ring with a quartz set high, the way old miners wore them. A seam found by its wearer tends to run a little deeper.

name: Quartz Seedsaver's Ring
description: A thin Ambren ring with quartz set like seeds along a furrow. At harvest, now and then, something is left over for next year.

name: Quartz Hearty Amulet
description: A round Ambren locket with a quartz in its face, worn close to the chest. Bread eaten in a hard moment seems to go further.

name: Quartz Wayfinder's Amulet
description: An Ambren pendant shaped like a milestone, a quartz at its top. Walkers who wear one tend to notice what lies at the roadside.

name: Quartz Baitkeeper's Amulet
description: An Ambren fish on a cord, with quartz for its eye. What goes on the hook or under the snare is not always taken.

name: Wolfskin Cloak
description: Twenty grey pelts sewn fur-side out, heavy at the shoulders and long enough to sit on. It turns the wind and the odd tooth.

name: Lanai Spinning Wheel
description: A treadle wheel of Lanai wood with a flyer and bobbin. Fibre goes in at the hand and comes out as thread at the spindle.

name: Lanai Loom
description: A floor loom of Lanai wood, heddles and all. Thread goes on as warp and comes off as a bolt of cloth.
